whyCountry.title: Why choose an Italian number?
body: Italians organize their days in WhatsApp, and Telegram has carved out a notably strong following in Italy — channels, communities and news feeds thrive there. Add Instagram, where Italian food, fashion and travel culture practically live, and a +39 number covers the accounts that matter most in the Italian market. For a country at the heart of European tourism, an Italian Airbnb account rounds out the picture.

Italian mobile numbers start with 3 after the +39 code — the 3XX prefix instantly marks a number as mobile rather than landline. It's a well-worn EU format that sign-up forms across Europe and beyond accept without hesitation.

tips.title: 3XX means mobile in Italy
tips.body: Italian landlines start with 0 and mobiles with 3, so the 3XX prefix is the giveaway services look for. Numbers from SMS Code use the mobile format — exactly what verification flows expect.
